about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (Hosea 12:12–14:9) recalls how Jacob fled to Aram and served for a wife. It ends with Hosea’s call to return: “Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God,” with God’s promise to heal and love freely. The reading from the Apostles (John 1:43–51) points back to Jacob’s dream at Bethel. Yeshua tells Nathanael, “an Israelite in whom there is no deceit,” that he will see angels ascending and descending on the Son of Man.
